content.title: Why shares of this power equipment company have doubled this year
content.description:
Shares of American Superconductor (AMSC) have surged over 120% in 2025 year-to-date as grid reliability and power demand for AI infrastructure dominate the headlines in the energy landscape.

American Superconductor Chairman, CEO, and President Daniel McGahn discusses the company's expansion past superconductors into developing power control equipment, how it benefits US electrical grid systems, and the timeline for better adapting the grid to AI data center demands.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
